tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run at chem_opt = 170 with Noah (sf_surface_physics = 2), data/eqwefic/chem170_scm, dumped by ctessum-claude/WRF branch earthsciml-instrumented-chem170 and replayed through the real64 (-fdefault-real-8) kernels/noah_driver at ESM_DT = 0.01 s. Inputs are the dumped SFLX arguments (real32 values widened); expected values are the real64 replay. PENMAN runs on the INPUT state, before NOPAC advances anything, so none of these outputs depends on dt. rch, rr, t24, epsca and the ssoil PENMAN is called with are not Registry variables and are published by the kernels/noah_esm_*.inc splices into a build-time copy of module_sf_noahlsm.F (the WRF source is untouched). Snow-free (sncovr = 0), liquid precipitation (snowng = frzgra = .false.), aoasis = 1, ua_phys = .false.: pre-dawn, etp near zero.
